Name: Ephraim
Summary: Ephraim was Joseph's second son by Asenath, born in Egypt before the famine.
KeyStory: Joseph named him Ephraim, saying God had made him fruitful in the land of his affliction — and Jacob crossed his hands to bless Ephraim above Manasseh.
RelatedPeople: Joseph, Son of Jacob; Asenath; Manasseh
LifeLesson: God's blessing does not always follow birth order — He chooses as He wills.
